relationship: Building a flowchart connects control decisions and operations to an automated-system challenge and its test run.

learnerLoop.action: Place, connect and configure flowchart symbols, then run the challenge test.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The chart structure and selected symbol configuration change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The chart, challenge status and test result show whether the control logic works.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Revise a branch, operation or connection to meet the goal.

invariants: A test evaluates the chart the learner constructed.
Flowchart connections remain the representation of the control flow.
safeAdaptations: Change the challenge scenario, guidance or available examples while preserving editable flowchart construction and testing.
nonGoals: Simulating physical hardware beyond the represented automated control logic.

task.description: Overall routing goal and current stage goal, test criteria and shared routing chips in the inline working area above the bottle line.
task.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

controls.description: Place/configure symbols, connect the chart, arrange it and run the physical test.
controls.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

model.description: Growing controller chart beside the bottle line and active sensor/processor/actuator.
model.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

evidence.description: Stable inline working readout for editing diagnostics, the running step and test outcome; batch route chips and stage pass state.
evidence.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

mass.domain: Acceptance from 490 to 510 g inclusive; supplied challenge tests include out-of-range bottles.
mass.output: Sensor reading, processor decision and ship/reject route.

chart.domain: Terminator, input/output, process and decision nodes; directed connections.

modes.stages: Sense, Decide, Act and Repeat unlock sequentially while retaining the chart.

dependencies: Each stage checks symbol type, statement and connections before running its physical cases.
Decision YES and NO branches remain distinct; repeat branches reconnect to the pressure-sensor input.
Editing and physical test controls stay below the goal. Placement/wiring guidance and symbol configuration are inline; one working readout replaces chart/device popups.
The chart expands down the page; the factory and its SVG device artwork remain paired with it.
implementation.completion: All four challenge tests pass, including correct repeat routing.
limitations: A fixed automated bottle-line teaching model. Model-specific symbol geometry and directed arrows are retained.
